/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path('src/data/lyrics/qaid-mein-hun.md')
text = path.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
before, roman, source = re.split(r'(  Zindaan-e-sitam[\\s\\S]+?)(?=\\n---\\n)', text, maxsplit=1)
for old, new in {
    'maiṅ': 'main',
    'Maiṅ': 'Main',
    'meiṅ': 'mein',
    'chahiti': 'chaheti',
    'faryaad': 'fariyaad',
    'Khuṅ': 'Khuṅ',
    'Is sher taraai': 'Is sher taraai',
    'darr lagta': 'dar lagta',
    'mera wasila': 'mera wasila',
    'Zawwaaroṅ': 'Zawwaaroṅ',
    'Karb o Bala mein raste mein pare': 'Karb o Bala mein raste mein pare',
}.items():
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
updated = before + roman + source
assert updated.split('\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == text.split('\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
roman_blocks = roman.strip().split('\\n\\n')
source_blocks = source.split('\\n---\\n', 1)[1].strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert len(roman_blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 11
for index, (roman_block, source_block) in enumerate(zip(roman_blocks, source_blocks)):
    roman_lines = roman_block.splitlines()
    source_lines = source_block.splitlines()
    assert len(roman_lines) == len(source_lines)
    if index >= 2:
        assert int(roman_lines[0]) == int(source_lines[0]) == index - 1
path.write_bytes(updated.encode('utf-8'))

item.text:
Audited all 78 verses in [qaid-mein-hun.md](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/2/workspaces/f0fe2543c75342b1806b4167487aed9c/src/data/lyrics/qaid-mein-hun.md) against the Urdu and verified their alignment. Corrected `main` and `mein` throughout, along with `chaheti`, `fariyaad`, and `dar`. The Urdu text and metadata were preserved.

Stanza 5’s `sher taraai` remains as transcribed. The source spelling `شیر ترای` leaves that reading uncertain and needs editorial sign-off.
